verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents public REST and GraphQL APIs alongside many SDKs. Its CLI and MCP server sit on top of the same API, and they cover projects, rows, files, users and functions, so agents can drive the whole product programmatically. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use, documented API-key/auth details for headless programmatic access in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use one of our many SDKs or integrate directly through the REST API or GraphQL API.
It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.
This includes creating and managing projects, managing resources (rows, files, users), creating and deploying Appwrite Functions, and other operations available through Appwrite's API.
Appwrite offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows LLMs to directly interact with Appwrite's API and docs.
